about.acknowledgements.openCascade.comment: Plain paragraph in the About page's Acknowledgements card, under the Open CASCADE license sentence. Not formatted. Keep the product names Open CASCADE Technology and OPEN CASCADE SAS unchanged. It is the copyright line the LGPL asks the app to show, followed by a note that the 3D import helper's source and a written offer for the library source are public; a link row named by about.link.openSource follows it.
about.acknowledgements.openCascade.en: Open CASCADE Technology is copyright OPEN CASCADE SAS and its contributors. The source of the 3D import helper and the written offer for the library source are public.

about.acknowledgements.openCascade.id: Hak cipta Open CASCADE Technology dimiliki OPEN CASCADE SAS dan para kontributornya. Kode sumber pembantu impor 3D dan penawaran tertulis untuk kode sumber pustaka tersedia untuk umum.

about.acknowledgements.openCascade.ha: Haƙƙin mallaka na Open CASCADE Technology na OPEN CASCADE SAS ne da masu ba da gudummawarsa. Tushen naʼurar taimakon shigo da 3D da rubutaccen tayin tushen ɗakin karatu a bayyane suke ga kowa.
